reason: We came off E-Golf4U less than a year ago and the volunteers are exhausted; I can't go back to the board and the members with another switch now, no matter how well the pilot is set up. The offer is honestly better than most, but the timing is wrong for us.
objection: Our older members just barely learned the new system, and they will not install yet another app. A second migration in two years would cost us goodwill and maybe more members, and with two founders and one pilot club I'd be betting the club on a very young company.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing Golfclub Zwolle's results after a full season, with real numbers on older members actually using the app, and timing it for when our current contract comes up for renewal in a year or two.
